title: Pattern 14: Private Agentic Reasoning RAG Deployment
description: Schema for Pattern 14 Private Vertex AI Reasoning Engine agent coupled with Vertex AI RAG Engine knowledge corpus, dedicated VPC, Serverless VPC Access connector, restricted IAM invokers, and optional Cloud Run serving service.

project_id.description: GCP Project ID hosting Vertex AI Reasoning Engine and RAG Engine.

region.description: GCP region for resources (Reasoning Engine is supported in us-central1).

use_existing_network.description: Whether to use an existing VPC network instead of creating a new one.

network_name.description: Name of the custom VPC network to create if use_existing_network is false.

existing_network_name.description: VPC network ID or self link if use_existing_network is true.

existing_connector_id.description: Existing Serverless VPC Access connector ID if use_existing_network is true.

agent_framework.description: Agent framework tag: google-adk | langchain | langgraph | llamaindex | custom.

source_archive_gcs_uri.description: GCS URI of the packaged source code archive (.tar.gz).

requirements_gcs_uri.description: GCS URI of the Python requirements.txt file.

python_version.description: Python runtime version for Reasoning Engine container.

corpus_name.description: Name for the Vertex AI RAG corpus.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model resource name for RAG Engine corpus.

allowed_invoker_members.description: List of IAM members permitted to invoke the Reasoning Engine and Cloud Run service.

enable_cloud_run.description: Enable optional Cloud Run frontend / API gateway layer.

container_image.description: Container image URL deployed to Cloud Run.

labels.description: Resource labels attached to all resources.
